    The Ick: Live!

    9:30 PM · Brooklyn Improv (The Main Room), Williamsburg · $33.36

    Submit Your Ick (@submityourick) is the Webby, Telly, and Shorty Award-winning internet home for the ick: that one tiny, irrational thing a person does that makes you never want to see them again. What started as an Instagram account collecting anonymous dating confessions has grown into a community of more than 700,000 followers, over 120 million views, and more than 20,000 submissions. For years, our followers have confessed their icks to us anonymously. Now we're putting the ick to the test in front of a live audience. Comedians and longtime friends Emily Wilson and Sam Blumefeld will guide our bachelorette along her romantic journey. Sam actually officiated Emily's wedding, so they both know a thing or two about love. Emily is a New York comedian whose special was recently featured in the New York Times. Sam is a comedian and writer who collaborates closely with Chloe Troast on Spilling Your Seed. Each round of the night is designed to draw out exactly the kind of Icky moments our followers have been submitting for years. One bachelorette will date four bachelors behind a wall. At the end of every round, the bachelorette hits the ick button and sends one bachelor home. The last man standing gets the date. DO NOT PURCHASE TICKETS FROM ANYONE OR ANY OTHER SITE OTHER THAN IMPROV.COM TICKET RESALE IS STRICTLY PROHIBITED. TICKETS SUSPECTED OF BEING PURCHASED FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF RESELLING MAY BE CANCELLED AT THE DISCRETION OF THE BROOKLYN IMPROV. No cell phone use, photography or video recording is permitted during performances. All sales are final.     A Ghost in Your Ear

    7:00 PM · Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre, Greenwich Village · ↻ Every Thursday Para salir

    When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.

    Boletos e info →

    🎭

    The Conversation

    7:00 PM · Astor Place Theatre, Greenwich Village · ↻ Every Thursday Para salir

    THE CONVERSATION follows Marcus (Tony Award-winner Joshua Henry) and Elle (Julia Harriman) from the electric spark of their first date to move-ins, milestones, and the slow accumulation of everything left unsaid. The score, written by Henry and Harriman, weaves soul, R&B, and modern pop into bold musical theater storytelling that is intimate, honest, and emotionally gripping. With a book by Nick Green and directed by Tony Award-winner Kenny Leon, The Conversation asks what it takes to choose love, even when it hurts, and what it takes to stay.

    Led by veteran trumpeter Simon Wettenhall and Grammy winning pianist Conal Fowkes, The High Society New Orleans Jazz Band are a New Orleans style Jazz band which for decades have been Woody Allens band of choice for his movies, concert tours and weekly performances.The band have appeared on all the premiere concert stages of Europe and the United States.     Music Makers Tribute to the Heavy Hitters

    6:00 PM · Iridium, Midtown-Times Square · $27.18

    Music Makers Tribute to... The Heavy Hitters bring some of the biggest artists, most influential songs, and most enduring sounds in music history to one of New York City's most iconic live music stages: the Iridium in the heart of Times Square. Featuring two distinct tribute experiences, The Heavy Hitters will move across genres and generations, celebrating artists whose music has become part of the soundtrack of our lives. Whether you're drawn to the powerhouse vocals and deep grooves of classic soul or the unmistakable piano-driven hits of Billy Joel and Elton John, you'll have the opportunity to enjoy music that has inspired generations of musicians and audiences. SOUL ROYALTY: The Voices That Defined Soul﻿ Soul Royalty celebrates the legendary singers, unforgettable grooves, and timeless songs that defined the genre---from Aretha Franklin, Otis Redding, Sam Cooke, and Marvin Gaye to Al Green, Stevie Wonder, and beyond. KINGS OF KEYS: The Piano Legends Who Changed Music ﻿Billy Joel. Elton John. Two legendary piano players. Decades of unforgettable songs. ﻿Step into the world of piano-driven classic rock and delight in the iconic parts, soaring melodies, and timeless songs that made these artists household names. I'm Every Woman starring Mona Swain presented by 24k Theatre Co. 24k Theatre Co. presents I'm Every Woman, starring Mona Swain! From portraying Tina Turner in the national tour of TINA: The Tina Turner Musical to bringing Whitney Houston's iconic hits to life in The Bodyguard and stepping into the world of Donna Summer, Mona has embodied three of music's most legendary women. For one night only, experience Mona bringing all three of her iconic roles together on one stage at The Iridium! Presented by 24k Theatre Co., an acclaimed, female-led, internationally based production company whose credits include Just a Piano, Night of the Living Legends, and productions at 54 Below, The Triad, and the Toronto Fringe Festival. Dedicated to honoring the past while shaping the future, 24k brings its signature celebration of extraordinary talent and timeless music to this unforgettable evening! Mad Staggers Get ready for a detonation of unapologetic, dirty rock and roll as NYC's premier powerpop-infused outfit, the Mad Staggers, bring their ferocious, high-voltage energy to the legendary stage at The Iridium. Known for tearing up the local club scene with an old-school rock mentality, this formidable four-piece combines the gritty charisma of The Faces with heavy powerpop hooks. Fronted by the magnetic Chris Campion, the lineup features Benny Landa on guitar, Gary Bristol on bass, and Keith Foley driving the beat on drums. About Music Makers Bob Elliott's Music Makers is NYC's premier band ensemble program, where business professionals and passionate music enthusiasts come together to rehearse, refine their craft, and perform live. BEMM has performed over 700 shows at iconic venues like South Street Seaport, Alice Tully Hall, The Cutting Room, The Bitter End, and many more, delivering unforgettable live music experiences. In addition to musicianship development, we also provide a top-tier rehearsal space, offering world-class service to musicians from around the globe.

    Crazy Chester: Tribute to The Band | Erik Vincent Huey

    8:00 PM · Bowery Palace, East Village · $24.88

    Formed in early 2020 for a series of one-off events in the piedmont region of North Carolina, Crazy Chester is a homegrown tribute act to The Band, consisting of Carrboro musicians Jones Bell (Mellow Swells, Ravary), Charles Cleaver (Big Star's Third, Fancy Gap, Lemon Sparks), Rob DiMauro (Heat Preacher, Mixtape Grab Bag, One After 919), Justin Ellis (Slow Teeth, Ravary, Easter Island, One After 919), and Rafael Green (solo artist, Ravary, One After 919), respectively recreating and playing the parts of Richard Manuel, Garth Hudson, Levon Helm, Rick Danko, and Robbie Robertson. For the sixth year in a row, Crazy Chester will be performing most of The Band's legendary farewell performance from Thanksgiving Day 1976, immortalized in the 1978 Martin Scorsese film "The Last Waltz" - complete with additional musicians and special local guests to play the songs originally performed in the film by Joni Mitchell, Bob Dylan, Neil Young, and many more. But this time - they're taking the show on the road to celebrate 50 Years of The Last Waltz. A show that must be seen to be believed. Full list of guest performers TBD!
